semantics: Damage timers precede effect expiry; ordinary every triggers and periodic instants follow expiry
Immediate-first damage ticks use a strict expiry bound; delayed-first ticks include the expiry boundary
Expiry-boundary damage uses expires_at minus _TICK_NUDGE for all queried buffs
DoT refresh preserves the old next tick; non-DoT periodic damage restarts phase
Timer iteration follows insertion/activation order, not effect-table order
Instant timers start after one interval, exclude expiry boundary, and reevaluate conditions on infinite durations
max_trigger is charged on registration, not on each periodic tick
Periodic instant heals and other actions retain synchronous target and nested event order
periodic_cpu_reference.care: Do not mark tick_interval accepted while skipping its effects. Runtime time-aware queries are preferable to weakening expiry semantics.
additional_compatibility: Charge last_bullet_fire is emitted at charge start
Lazy shield rank targets do not create eager shield HP snapshots in pinned CPU
Final query time filters buffs without physically expiring named active rows past the final actual frame

gauge_semantics: Per-owner gauge values / presence and base caps; ref_count truncates toward zero and registered zero shadows named stacks
Crossing events use sorted unique multiples from original old/new snapshot; nested consumers do not erase already crossed boundaries
Gauge max add sums raw fixed values of active entries without stack or runtime-condition scaling, matching pinned CPU
Finite passives refresh after expiry and before every timers; preserve tail after condition ends and respect reactivation budget
Ammo percentage uses Python ties-to-even rounding and clamps to zero / maximum; flat integer additions preserve CPU lower-bound behavior
Mode firing uses CPU measurement override before CDN; mode return resets original charge from ready; mode shots emit squad ammo events
follow_up_accuracy: Named callback channel 31 currently accepts ammo_charge_pct names only; extending it must implement buff / weapon event audiences and detect shared-name origins rather than silently accepting arbitrary event names.
Current source compiler uses fixed NE128 and at most three conditions; full objective requires eliminating these catalog/composition limits.
Consider a versioned kernel entry / manifest ABI when expanding EW or stat/event capacities, so stale persistent workers cannot load a new layout; current app updates require restarting the server.
damage_semantics: CPU factor multiplication and additive modifier order is reproduced before ties-to-even integer rounding
Armor-break flags bypass defense and independently combine with burst / shape / part modifiers
Fixed-charge numeric selection scans owner entries and uses latest (activation time, entry creation order); foreign locks without own numeric entry use base charge
Ordinary stack_count damage scales hit count, DoT scales coefficient, and exact B3 bonus_damage uses the landing-time reference to scale one deferred coefficient
Gauge suffix references distinguish registered zero from missing; explicit hit_count_gauge_ref defaults to zero while named suffix defaults to one
Static target masks use pinned class / squad / code / weapon / innate stage; future down/revive support must apply live eligibility on activation
Ordered base-charge targets preserve their order for synchronous healing
Enemy-target atk_caster_based_pct stays registered as an enemy ATK modifier and is excluded from outgoing ally damage
resolved_accuracy: consume_as_ammo keeps min(value,current) even when old-new cancels at large floating-point magnitudes; verified by the added gauge primitive
Fixed charge lookup avoids recursive stat() to retain the existing 65536-byte GPU stack limit
